title: GiveTools
description: A plugin that allows you to easily give any player(s) in your server (un)enchanted tools.
body:
This plugin allows you to give any player(s) on the server tools.

**USE:**

Command #1: /givetools | Syntax: /givetools <material (wooden -> netherite)> <level (1-7)> <extra (if other tools beyond the default sword, axe and pickaxe are given)>

Command #2: /givetool | Syntax: /givetool <tooltype (sword, pickaxe, axe, spear, mace, hoe, pickaxe, shovel)> <material (wooden -> netherite (none for mace))> from here on out enchants like unbreaking:3

Command #3: /givetoolshelp which tells you about /givetools and how to use it.
